entries.source: This vile abomination is a relative of ghouls, and often leads packs of them. It smells foul, and its bite carries a rotting disease.
entries.target: 这个肮脏的生物是食尸鬼的近亲，经常带领着一群食尸鬼。它散发着令人作呕的气息，噬咬会传染腐烂疫病。

entries.source: A giant black-skinned humanoid covered in spikey scabrous deposits.  Its face is featureless; its eyesockets, empty and hollow.
entries.target: 一个黑皮肤的巨大人形生物，全身覆盖着尖刺状的粗糙结块。它的脸没有五官；眼窝空空荡荡。

entries.source: A large sluglike creature with the face of a man.  Shadows seem to be drawn to its massive form, and your light dims as it approaches.
entries.target: 一只长着人脸的巨型蛞蝓状生物。阴影似乎都被吸向它庞大的身躯，当它靠近时，你的光源会变得暗淡。

entries.source: This crimson shape drips ceaselessly, spattering the nearby ground. The droplets seem to continue moving of their own volition.
entries.target: 这个血红色的物体不停滴落液体，溅洒在附近的地面上。滴落的液滴似乎仍在自行移动。

entries.source: A massive, amorphous blob of green slime crawls on the ground towards you. Eyes drift through the viscous mass, scanning for potential prey.
entries.target: 一团巨大的、无定形的绿色粘液在地面上向你爬来。一只只眼睛在这团黏稠物质中游移，搜寻潜在的猎物。

entries.source:
A vaguely tentacled yet rapidly changing shape floats here.  With each breath you can feel reality twist, shatter, and break. 
Blue burns into red, green bursts into yellow, and the air crackles and hisses before exploding into a thousand fragments of sharp shapes and colors.
entries.target: 一只不断变幻形态的触手生物漂浮在这里，每一次呼吸，你都能感到现实在扭曲、碎裂、崩坏。蓝色烧成红色，绿色爆成黄色，空气噼啪嘶鸣，随后炸裂成千片尖锐的形状与色彩。

entries.source: A pinkish bubble floats here, reflecting the world not as it is, but as it would be in that surreal place that exists only in our dreams.
entries.target: 一个粉红色的气泡漂浮在这里，反映的不是世界的本来面目，而是它在那个只存在于我们梦中的超现实之地里的模样。

entries.source: This powerful vortex of ice and lightning somehow gives you the impression of claws, teeth and intense hunger...
entries.target: 这个由冰和闪电组成的强大漩涡不知为何给你一种利爪、尖牙和强烈饥饿的印象……

entries.source: You don't want to think about what sort of creature this lamprey-like horror was feeding on to grow so large.  Its skin pulsates and writhes, like things are moving underneath...
entries.target: 你不想知道这个像七鳃鳗一样的恐魔是吃什么才能长这么大的。它的皮肤不停地搏动、扭曲，就像有东西在下面移动一样……

entries.source: Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.
entries.target: 几十个，也许几百个？各种形状和大小的、吸饱鲜血的蠕虫，由布满利齿的血盆大口和病态绿色皮肤组成的、翻腾的脓水海洋，随时准备缠住你并吸你的血，直到它们胀破或者你的静脉干涸。
格尔格勒克·黑暗吞噬者

entries.source:
A horror from the deepest pits of the earth. It looks like a huge pile of tentacles all trying to reach for you.
You can discern a huge round mouth covered in razor-sharp teeth.
entries.target: 这是来自地底最深处的恐魔。看起来像是一团巨大触手，它在不断的向你靠近。你可以在它那血盆大口里看到剃刀般的牙齿。

entries.source: This is one of Grgglck's tentacles. It looks more vulnerable than the main body.
entries.target: 这是格尔格勒克的一条触须。它看起来比主体更加脆弱。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#With Grgglck's death its tentacle also falls lifeless on the ground!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#随着格尔格勒克的死去它的那些触手也毫无生机地倒在了地上！

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#As #Source# falls you notice that #Target# seems to shudder in pain!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#当#Source#倒下时，你发现#Target#似乎因为痛苦而颤抖！

entries.source: This Blade Horror has been infused with intense temporal magic, causing its power to increase dramatically. Rifts in space open around it constantly, summoning and banishing blades before vanishing as quickly as they appear.
entries.target: 这只刀锋恐魔被强烈的时空魔法灌注，力量急剧提升。空间裂隙在它周围不断开启，召唤与放逐着刀刃，随后又像出现时一样迅速消失。

entries.source: Time seems to warp and bend around this floating weapon.
#AQUAMARINE#A rift opens and a free floating blade emerges!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#时空裂缝打开了，里面出现了一把浮空的刀刃！

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#The %s no longer seems to be controlled and clatters to the ground before vanishing into a rift.
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#%s 似乎失去了控制，坠落在地面，消失在时空裂隙中。

entries.source: This floating weapon shifts and shimmers, time and space warping and bending as it moves. It appears to vibrate, as if it may explode at any moment.
entries.target: 这件漂浮的武器不断晃动闪烁，移动时连时空也随之扭曲弯折。它似乎在震颤，仿佛随时都会爆炸。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#A rift opens and a free floating blade emerges! It looks unstable...
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#时空裂缝打开了，里面出现了一把浮空的刀刃！它看起来很不稳定…

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s explodes into a huge bubble of air!
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#%s爆炸，成为了一个巨大的气泡！

entries.source: This massive stony structure shifts and pulsates, its many long, thin tentacles probing the nearby water for food.
entries.target: 这个巨大的石状生物震动起伏着，它许多细长的触手在附近的水中探测食物。

entries.source: This tiny fish-like creature moves erratically, but is constantly surrounded by others of its kind.
entries.target: 这种小鱼状生物行动飘忽不定，但身边总是围着一群同类。

entries.source: A vile looking liquid flows from the teeth of this agile monster. It glides through the water towards you, spined fins jutting outwards.
entries.target: 这个敏捷怪物的牙齿中不断滴落邪恶的液体，它穿过水面向你滑行，带刺的鳍向外凸出。

entries.source: This frothing ball of water rages with an intense heat.
entries.target: 这个冒着泡沫的水球带着强烈的热度汹涌而来。

entries.source: This titanic mass of flesh pulsates and churns as tiny monsters burst from its orifices.
entries.target: 巨大的肉块不断搏动、翻搅，小怪物从它的孔窍中迸出。

entries.source: This pitch black form is shrouded in darkness. All you can make out are a pair of deep red eyes, hidden behind a mass of tentacles.
entries.target: 这个深黑的物体被黑暗围绕，你只能认出一对猩红的眼睛，藏在一堆触手后面。

entries.source: A small pink-skinned humanoid with large bulbous eyes.
entries.target: 一只小小的粉皮人形生物，长着巨大的球状眼睛。

entries.source: A hulking pink-skinned creature with long arms as thick as tree trunks.  It drags its knuckles on the ground as it lumbers toward you.
entries.target: 一只庞大的粉皮肤生物，手臂粗如树干。它拖着指关节，笨重地向你走来。

entries.source: A thin pink-skinned creature with long spindly arms.  Half its body is old and wrinkly, and the other half appears quite young.
entries.target: 一只纤瘦的粉皮肤生物，长着细长的手臂。它半边身体又老又皱，另外半边却显得相当年轻。

entries.source: A slender metallic monstrosity with long claws in place of fingers, and razor-sharp teeth.
entries.target: 瘦长的金属怪物，手指的位置长着长长的爪子，还有剃刀般锋利的牙齿。

entries.source: It looks like a hole in spacetime, but you get the impression it's somehow more than that.
entries.target: 它乍一看像是时空中的一道缝隙，但你对它的印象远远不止于此。
